fluff.overview: Reforms begun under Alessandro Steiner and reinforced by Federated Suns influence have integrated Lyran infantry into combined-arms operations more effectively than at any point in the Commonwealth's history. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Armed with assault rifles backed by portable machine guns, these platoons combine individual marksmanship with sustained suppressive fire from crew-served weapons that can pin down opposing formations.
